$comment: Published-model registry for Tukuk-OS. One entry per model WE trained (or fine-tuned) — trained on a Kaggle GPU, stored on the Hugging Face hub, installed onto this server by scripts/hf-model-pull.sh. src/brain/modelhub.js only READS this file plus the local filesystem: nothing here opens a socket, so /api/models cannot hang. 'installed' is never stored — it is derived at request time from the presence of hfFile in models.localDir. Verified numbers live in the HF model card + metrics.json produced by the training kernel; do not invent values here.

models.name: Tukuk Builder Mini
models.role: Coding assistant for Tukuk Builder (LoRA fine-tune, GGUF for CPU inference)
models.notes: Trained from a public permissively licensed instruction dataset inside the Kaggle kernel — the private Tukuk-OS corpus is never uploaded to Kaggle. Honest metrics (loss, tokens, wall-clock, GGUF sha256) are written to metrics.json in the same HF repo.
